===== Dockerfile =====
FROM node:22-slim

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    curl \
    libnss3 \
    libnspr4 \
    libatk1.0-0 \
    libatk-bridge2.0-0 \
    libcups2 \
    libdrm2 \
    libdbus-1-3 \
    libxkbcommon0 \
    libxcomposite1 \
    libxdamage1 \
    libxfixes3 \
    libxrandr2 \
    libgbm1 \
    libasound2 \
    libpango-1.0-0 \
    libcairo2 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /usr/src/app

COPY package*.json ./

RUN npm ci

RUN npx playwright install chromium --with-deps

COPY . .

EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["node", "src/server.js"]===== seeder dir =====
    "name": "seeder.js",
